[h1]OUTMINER[/h1]

[h3]You're the captain of a ship in the middle of the most important delivery of your life. However, an unexpected failure forces your ship to crash into an uncharted planet where you'll have to learn, adapt, and survive in order to escape alive.

Take control of your fate, fight against the odds, and get out of the unforgiving planet before it's too late.

Your crew is counting on you... Do not let them down![/h3]

notes.title: Succubus Summon - Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43353082/8ae300d8a350f5276539496a259a755cdb26d772.png[/img]

[h3]Hi there, Succubus Summon dark disciples!

We have a great announcement for all of you out there. Starting now, Succubus Summon trading cards are available on Steam! You can gain up to three random trading cards whenever you play the game long enough.

You can get Succubus Summon exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emotes!

You can now obtain a set of five distinctive cards with different looks. The trading cards can be crafted as well so you can upgrade your Succubus Summon badges and display them on your Steam profile.

We hope you enjoy the simple yet elegant looks of our favorite badges.

As always, be careful while performing dark arts in the Succubus Summon world![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213660/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23742/
